findings: `run_id: ""` at PO-level approval — settlement/page.tsx sends an empty string for run_id when approving at the PO level. If the backend validates run_id as non-empty, PO-level approvals will fail with a 422. Fix: make run_id optional on the backend for PO-level approvals, or gate the button on a known run.

`audit_id: ""` in HITL approve from run panel — dispatch/page.tsx sends audit_hash ?? "" as audit_id. When audit_hash is absent from the run result (it is optional on E2ERunResult), an empty string is sent. The approve button should be disabled until runResult.audit_hash is populated.

`clearing_price?` spec vs `clearing_price_inr` implementation — the Auction type uses clearing_price_inr; the checklist spec named the field clearing_price?. Internally consistent but diverges from the written spec. Confirm field name against the API contract.
